description: A routed multi-Skill plugin for anti-slop editing, voice preservation, short-line and staccato cleanup, spoken and Arabic writing, strict house rules, truthful commercial copy, and visual-content review.

defaultPrompt: Clean this draft up and apply my strict writing rules: [paste draft]
Write this marketing piece in natural Egyptian Arabic without AI phrasing: [brief]
Review this presentation copy and design direction for content and RTL slop: [paste brief]
interface.longDescription: Slop Curator is a skills-only Plugin built as a connected set of full specialist Skills. It audits named slop patterns, detects excessive short-line and staccato formatting, preserves an existing writer voice, reconstructs natural spoken prose, handles Egyptian Arabic and Arabic-English code-switching, enforces portable or strict house-style rules, builds truthful commercial copy and practical marketing playbooks, reviews presentation and visual-content direction for AI-design clichés and RTL risks, applies targeted repairs, and runs a final quality gate. The router loads only the Skills and policy profiles needed for the request so personal house rules do not become universal bans. No external server or authentication is required.

name: no-ai-slop
